title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode3 You're Going Too?

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
There we go!
Just cut through here, and we can head straight for the station.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never knew a shortcut like this existed...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How did you find this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I was wandering around here one time and just found this place by complete accident.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki.
You helped us so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hey, what's what...?
It looks like they're getting ready for something...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That board says, Shibuya Summer Festival...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, the Shibuya Summer Festival...
I think I went once when I was still in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I remember it being a lot of fun because of all the food stalls and the concert they put on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
A concert?
I wonder who's performing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We can probably find out pretty quick on our phones... See? Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... Hey, there's a ton of people performing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! ZEROstear's coming?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: ZEROstear? Oh, the artist that does a lot of anime songs?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They did the opening theme for a really popular show this season too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know much about anime, but they know how to get famous artists, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's just wall-to-wall A-listers!
Wait, I'm not sure who A-GURI is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Did you say, A-GURI...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you know who they are, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... They're not all that famous yet, but they've started gaining some popularity with the videos they've been posting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was under the impression that they wouldn't perform live, so it took me by surprise a little...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So it's not just famous people?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's an amateur division that's separate from the pro stage too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I see that. These mostly look like dance teams, but some good singing groups are apparently coming too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, so this is meant to have a whole range of amateur and professional artists performing all together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, they all seem pretty into this...!
This could be a chance to have Mizuki go out with us too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, since this is happening, why don't we all go see this show?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I think I'll pass...
It's still gonna be pretty hot out, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've been to an outdoor event like this before and I came back completely exhausted. I'm not sure Kanade could handle it, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She might collapse from heat-stroke.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Urgh... Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But it says they're doing it at night.
It should be much cooler by then, so we should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Still...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If we bring a lot of cold drinks, do you think we'll be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, you wanna go?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've never been to an outdoor concert like this, but I am interested in seeing A-GURI perform live. I may not get this chance in the future...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's no way Mafuyu's gonna be free...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have cram school that day, but classes should end early. I shouldn't have to prepare much for next time either, so I think I can go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, seriously?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then it's settled. You're coming too, Mizuki. I mean, some artists you like are coming too, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, fine. I'll go...
My first Summer Festival in absolutely forever♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to be careful not to suffer from heat-stroke. Mizuki, would you mind telling us what we should be bringing to an event like this later?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you got it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I'll message all of you once I get more details too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I think I'm going to be running late, I'll let everyone know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks.
Let's enjoy this as much as we can since we all get to go!
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's a lot harder than I expected to make what we already have better...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We're gonna have to keep practicing to be able to sing while we do all this too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But these shoes I got yesterday are nice. They're lighter and easier to move around in than anything I've ever worn before...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I should go over that last dance one more time.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: So you're going to the Summer Festival with your friends this weekend...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hm? This weekend...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yup! So I won't be needing dinner!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That's fine by me. Have fun but be safe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Ena's home already...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hold on, she said Summer Festival. Did she mean the Shibuya Summer Festival? And Ena's going?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If she sees me and Toya performing... I don't want to think about it more than that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, you're home?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that bag you're holding... It's from that new store that just opened, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's nothing.
What does it matter if I...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, are these dancing shoes?
Lemme see! Are you gonna wear them to an event or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, hands off. I didn't say you could...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Don't you think this design's a little out of your league, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Quit it. Who asked you anyway?
And give them back already!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, okay.
Have fun practicing with them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The Summer Festival, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I wonder if she still remembers what happened back then...)
